FRAME FORMAT: 1536 × 1536 pixels. EXACTLY SIX COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, eighteen isolated complete sprites, 256 × 512 pixels per cell. Even gutters and transparent padding. Common proportional physical scale; fixed pivots. No labels or visible grid. 
Use case: stylized-concept. Production modular Raiden-style shmup asset kit.
The reference is a strip of THREE COMPLETE BARE HULLS, left-to-right. Create FINISHED MATCHING HARDWARE for each hull. Row1 uses the LEFT hull identity. Row2 uses the MIDDLE hull identity. Row3 uses the RIGHT hull identity. Match the exact paint color, metal shading, bevel widths, rivets, seams and design vocabulary of EACH respective hull. This corrects a real failure where green generic hardware was installed on red, purple, orange and tan hulls. Never substitute generic olive parts.
ROW1 belongs exclusively to Steel Interceptor: charcoal/silver gunmetal, narrow swept angular wings, no olive paint.
ROW2 belongs exclusively to Red Needle Fighter: scarlet red armor with silver central metal and black seams, slender swept needle wings; no green paint.
ROW3 belongs exclusively to Teal Strike Drone: deep desaturated teal with gunmetal trim, compact angular drone wings.
EVERY ROW has the SAME SIX ROLES in this order: Column1: a complete LEFT WING, tip extending left and finished root connector at right. Column2: matching complete RIGHT WING, tip extending right and finished root at left. Column3: complete LEFT jet ENGINE nacelle, intake facing BOTTOM and nozzle toward TOP. Column4: matching complete RIGHT jet ENGINE nacelle. Column5: complete AUTOCANNON POD, closed mounting housing at top, barrel facing down. Column6: complete MISSILE POD with closed painted housing and silver red-tipped missiles facing down.
Each component is a COMPLETE separately reusable manufactured object with its own finished outline, opaque casing, and full mounting connector, no broken cuts, no holes shaped from missing components. DO NOT draw any hull or vehicle on this sheet, and do not attach the parts to each other. One part per cell, all eighteen distinct and separated by transparency. Do not omit, merge or reorder cells. All are directly overhead orthographic SOUTH-facing. Preserve each base's material palette throughout all SIX parts of its matching row. Steel gun barrels remain gray, cyan optics cyan, missiles silver/red and rubber black; do NOT colorize everything with the paint. Wings are anatomically designed as continuations of their OWN reference fuselage and share its angular silhouette, with reinforced inner root connectors. Wings about200px wide ×240px long, engines about75px wide ×170px long, gun pods65px ×190px long, missile pods85px ×170px long. No giant circular nacelles or bulky tanks on slender fighters.
Dense hand-clustered 1990s Raiden military pixel art, stepped dark outlines, metallic highlights matching the attached exact hulls. No soft airbrush, no cartoon icons, no isometric angle, no cast shadows, text, labels, effects, flames or scene. True transparent background.
